description: PostgreSQL 18 Unicode preservation, NUL rejection, pattern matching, and deterministic ICU locale ordering
sql: SELECT collprovider, collisdeterministic, colllocale FROM pg_collation WHERE collname = 'en-x-icu';
CREATE TABLE type_matrix_unicode_patterns (id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, value TEXT COLLATE "en-x-icu");
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX type_matrix_unicode_patterns_locale_idx ON type_matrix_unicode_patterns (value);
SELECT value FROM type_matrix_unicode_patterns ORDER BY value;
SELECT ('é' COLLATE "C") = ('é' COLLATE "C"), ('é' COLLATE "en-x-icu") = ('é' COLLATE "en-x-icu"), ('ä' COLLATE "en-x-icu") < ('z' COLLATE "en-x-icu"), ('ä' COLLATE "C") < ('z' COLLATE "C");
